name: With Wind Beneath Your Wings
summary: A Squall-breakers Potion offers brief protection from the storm’s elements. You are sent back to Rau Cliffrunner at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.

sections.title: Back to Freewind
sections.body: A storm still threatens your friends, and the potion’s protection lasts only a short while. Return to Rau Cliffrunner at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles, where your friends are waiting in need.

faq.answer: The Squall-breakers Potion protects you against the elements of the storm for a short while.
Return to Rau Cliffrunner at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.
You are being sent back to your friends in need.

attribution: In-game quest text: With Wind Beneath Your Wings
